title: A Shore Thing
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at “A Shore Thing”, a luxury 8-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 28 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Private pool with swim-up bar & Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $90 per day from October 1-May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 -Gulf views -Six-Seater golf cart included -6 bikes Included -Elevator Sleek coastal contemporary design perfectly situated to capture gulf views and masterfully configured providing unparalleled amenities including a massive private resort style pool area complete with a stone waterfall feature and swim up bar as well as an adjoining spa and covered outdoor summer kitchen and living area. This home was designed to maximize functionality and finely appointed with chic contemporary finishes while affording optimal comfort & living space. Notable features include multiple indoor and outdoor living areas, private commercial grade elevator, dual master suites with gulf views, built-in pinterest style bunk beds, as well as indoor and outdoor surround sound system. The first floor layout boasts dual bunk rooms, a large bedroom with ensuite bath as well as an industrial style game room complete with a pool table & built in wet bar including a full size Sub-Zero fridge. The second floor is the focal point of indoor living space with a spacious living room featuring pecky cypress ceilings, floor to ceiling windows to soak in the beautiful gulf views, gas fireplace, built-in entertainment center and open to the massive dining area overlooking the rear amenities. The ample sized kitchen features floor-to-ceiling custom cabinetry, paneled Sub-Zero appliances and Wolf professional series gas range, walk-in pantry and large center island with gorgeous shell infused custom countertops. The second floor also features two full bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms & half bath as well as access to the second story outdoor dining area overlooking the lagoon style pool. The third floor features three full bedrooms including dual master suites with wrap around porches, laundry area as well as a fourth story viewing deck to maximize the incredible gulf and lake views that surround this prestigious home. Centrally located near Destin's world class golfing, dining, shopping & entertainment. The property includes on-site parking for up to 8 vehicles. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor -King Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower only Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds and One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed- Private Bathroom with Shower only Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed Second Floor - King Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Third Floor - King Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - King Bed and One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - King Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower Only
